========================================================================
[ID] PETUNJUK PENEMPATAN FILE DISC (HARVEST MOON: BACK TO NATURE)
========================================================================
Untuk memainkan port PC ini secara legal, Anda perlu menyediakan salinan
disc image (dump) Harvest Moon: Back to Nature versi USA milik Anda sendiri.

Tempatkan file berikut ke dalam folder ini (game\):
1. Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).cue
2. Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).bin

Atau file terkompresi CHD:
- Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).chd
(Jika menggunakan format .chd, ubah baris `disc = "..."` pada file `game.toml` menjadi:
 disc = "game/Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).chd")

Setelah file ditaruh di folder ini, jalankan "Play_Harvest_Moon_PC.bat"!

========================================================================
[EN] INSTRUCTIONS FOR DISC IMAGE PLACEMENT
========================================================================
To legally play this native PC port, you need to provide your own dumped
disc image of Harvest Moon: Back to Nature (USA version).

Place the following files in this folder (game\):
1. Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).cue
2. Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).bin

Or compressed CHD format:
- Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).chd
(If using .chd, edit `game.toml` line:
 disc = "game/Harvest Moon - Back to Nature (USA).chd")

Once files are placed here, double-click "Play_Harvest_Moon_PC.bat" to play!
========================================================================
